title: The Code Word Taught in Full
youtube_title: The Code Word Taught in Full | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Tove is just outside the fun, close to a code word taught all the way, not half. Uma changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Tove has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
